item.title: User Acquisition Manager
item.description:
Location: Remote · Hours: at least 4h overlap with US Eastern (~3–7pm CET) · Type: Full-time, B2B contract

Haven is hiring on behalf of MenuFit (menufit.com · App Store) — the app that tells you exactly what to order at any restaurant to hit your goals. MenuFit launched in August 2025 and went from $0 to $1M+ in monthly revenue in under a year, completely bootstrapped and profitable. It's a top 10 app for eating out healthy, with 3M+ downloads and a 4.8★ rating from 54,000+ App Store reviews.

 

The role

You take over day-to-day media buying and report to the Head of Paid Ads: daily buying, budget allocation and the weekly creative test cycle, so the Head of Paid Ads can focus on creative strategy and new channels. Paid has been scaled from zero to a six-figure monthly budget in under a year, and the plan is to keep scaling aggressively through 2027. Your mandate is to grow spend while holding efficiency targets.

 

The account today

Meta is the core channel, with TikTok and Apple Search Ads also live and scaling. On Meta you'll run both in-app install campaigns and a growing web-to-app funnel. V2 of the app just shipped, so there's lots of fresh surface to test.

What you'll own

  • Scaling: growing spend across all live campaigns, in-app and web-to-app, and across geos.
  • Creative testing: launching new creative into test, reading results at the ad level and scaling what works.
  • Unit economics: calculating target cost per trial off current unit economics and holding the account to it; feeding trial-to-paid data back into buying decisions.
  • Reporting: pulling from Meta, Singular and paywall data, reconciling the sources and flagging when they drift apart.
  • Signal: working with the CTO on Event Match Quality, CAPI and deduplication.

 

What's NOT on your plate

Creative strategy and briefing (creative arrives ready to launch) · creator management · product, pricing and paywall · brand · lifecycle · ASO · people management.

 

Who we're looking for

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on paid media in consumer subscription apps, ideally iOS trial-to-paid.
  • Has personally run a Meta account at $1M+/month, hands-on in the account daily.
  • Fluent with an MMP (Singular ideal, AppsFlyer or Adjust fine): pulls your own data, joins it to Meta on IDs, and can explain why the sources disagree.
  • Post-ATT literate: works off a calibrated blended number, not platform-reported ROAS.
  • Deep on the signal side: EMQ, CAPI, server-side events, deduplication.
  • Comfortable with Advantage+ and broad targeting.
  • Web-to-app funnel experience (Superwall, FunnelFox or similar) alongside install campaigns.

 

Strong pluses: TikTok Ads; APIs / MCP tooling to build your own reporting; working alongside a creator or UGC program; health, fitness or nutrition apps; Apple Search Ads or AppLovin; having taken an account through a major signal change.

 

Compensation

  • Base + monthly performance bonus: $1K for hitting both the ROAS and spend targets, $2K for hitting both stretch targets.
  • Targets are set monthly with the Head of Paid Ads as the account scales.
  • 10–15 days PTO plus local public holidays.
  • Paid tooling and a budget for courses and industry events.

 

Why join

  • One of the fastest-growing accounts in consumer subscription apps, with real budget behind you from day one.
  • ~7x revenue growth in 12 months, bootstrapped and profitable.
  • Creative supply is solved: in-house creative director, UGC creators and 100+ influencers.
  • One product, one decision-maker. No client servicing, no decks, no approval chains.
  • Direct line to the Head of Paid Ads, the CTO and the founder; decisions get made the same day.
  • Room to grow: own the channel outright, open AppLovin, own the measurement model.

 

eam & reporting

~13-person core team. You report to James Norris, Head of Paid Ads, and work closely with the CTO and founder Cole Kosco

item.title: Customer support manager

item.title: Affiliate Manager
item.description:

Якщо ти вмієш будувати довгострокові партнерські відносини, орієнтуєшся в affiliate-маркетингу та хочеш працювати з ліцензованим продуктом у динамічній ніші iGaming — будемо раді познайомитися.
 

Вимоги:

  • Розуміння CPA-моделі та ключових метрик: CR, FTD, ROI/ROMI, LTV, Retention.
  • Аналітичне мислення та впевнена робота з Excel / Google Sheets.
  • Розуміння принципів роботи UTM-міток, трекінгу та постбеків.
  • Навички ділової комунікації та проведення переговорів.
  • Розуміння специфіки CPA-трафіку в iGaming та основних джерел залучення користувачів (SEO, PPC, ASO, In-App, Facebook, Telegram, Influencer Marketing тощо).
  • Вміння працювати зі спірними ситуаціями: холди, відмови, фрод-підозри.
  • Стресостійкість та здатність швидко приймати рішення.
  • Досвід роботи з різними GEO та міжнародними ринками (буде перевагою досвід роботи з Latam)

 

Основні обов’язки

  • Проведення онбордингу партнерів: налаштування постбеків, видача лінків, креативів та погодження умов роботи.

  • Аналіз ефективності джерел трафіку та підготовка рекомендацій щодо оптимізації.
  • Узгодження індивідуальних умов співпраці та ставок.
  • Моніторинг ринку, конкурентів та нових можливостей для залучення трафіку.
  • Участь у галузевих конференціях, нетворкінг-заходах та розвиток партнерської бази.

 

Буде перевагою:

  • Розуміння PWA, WebView та mobile flows.
  • Досвід роботи з платформами Affise, Scaleo та аналітичними інструментами (Power BI буде перевагою).

item.title: Lead of Military
item.description:
Eleven — рекрутингова агенція, яка спеціалізується на пошуку працівників для компаній у галузі військових технологій. Наша мета — підтримувати розвиток оборонної промисловості та допомагати об’єднувати тих, хто наближає до перемоги.

 

Роботодавець — українська компанія, яка займаємось виробництвом компонентів електроніки від ідеї до втілення! Компанія пропонує можливість реалізувати рішення та впливати на події уже зараз.

 

Шукаємо людину, яка очолить команду польових інженерів і відповідатиме за зворотний зв’язок від військових користувачів. Команда працюватиме безпосередньо з військовими підрозділами на прифронтових територіях. Завдання ліда: організувати роботу команди, допомагати визначати пріоритети розвитку продукту та виявляти комерційні можливості.

 

Обовʼязки:

  • Керувати командою польових інженерів: визначати пріоритети, розподіляти завдання, координувати виїзди з урахуванням вимог безпеки та розвивати команду.
  • Напряму працювати з військовими користувачами: проводити зустрічі та інтерв’ю, збирати відгуки й з’ясовувати, за яких умов виникають проблеми.
  • Систематизувати зворотний зв’язок, виявляти повторювані проблеми й оцінювати їхній вплив. Разом із продуктовою та інженерною командами формулювати вимоги до продукту й визначати пріоритети змін.
  • Після оновлень повертатися до користувачів і перевіряти, чи зміни вирішили їхні проблеми.
  • Виявляти комерційні можливості: відстежувати ринкові тренди, відкриті потреби по закупівлям, моніторити взаємодії підрозділів з міжнародними донорами (в контексті існуючих і потенційних продуктів), аналізувати специфічні вимоги замовників. Стисло фіксувати, що потрібно замовнику, які вимоги є обов’язковими та які питання потребують уточнення.
  •  

Вимоги:

  • Щонайменше 2 роки досвіду керування командою з 5 або більше людей.
  • Розвинені комунікаційні й аналітичні навички: вміння ставити точні запитання, чітко формулювати вимоги та співпрацювати з продуктовими й інженерними командами.
  • Готовність до відряджень, зокрема на прифронтові території, за погоджених умов безпеки.

item.title: Lead Cloud Architect / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Lead Cloud Builder)
item.description:
Description

Lead delivery of a large-scale migration to a European sovereign cloud platform for a tier-1 telecom/IT services client. You own the plan, the team and the evidence that the platform is operable, secure and compliant, from due diligence through scale-up to a 200+ FTE programme.

 

Role Context: This position requires a unique set of skills – we are looking for a “Builder”, not a “Consumer” of cloud services. The candidate will leverage architectural patterns, reliability standards, and concepts known from building public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) to design and implement a scalable environment based on the OpenStack ecosystem from the ground up. Crucially, the project is driven by an AI-First / AI-Native philosophy, requiring the architect to actively leverage Artificial Intelligence in the design, deployment, and operational phases of the cloud infrastructure.

Objective of the Role
Design, build, and deploy to production a fully functional, high-performance, and maintainable cloud environment based on OpenStack. Build the architecture in a way that “Day Zero” design decisions enable secure scaling, zero-downtime upgrades, and the seamless addition of new services in the future, while deeply embedding AI tools and AIOps practices into the very fabric of the infrastructure lifecycle.

Candidate Profile and Soft Skills

  • AI-Augmented Mindset: Naturally turns to AI tools to multiply their productivity, solve complex problems faster, and automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to foresee how the failure of a single disk, switch, or process will impact the entire cloud environment, and designing systems resilient to such events.
  • Service Provider Mindset: Architecting with the end-user (developer) in mind, providing them with reliable APIs and a self-service portal.
  • “Day-2 Operations” Approach: Awareness that launching the cloud is just the beginning. Designing the system with future upgrades and automated, AI-assisted remediation in mind.

 

Requirements

  • Building, not just consuming: Proven track record in deploying and maintaining OpenStack environments, or building IaaS/PaaS solutions at the Cloud Provider, Telco Cloud, or massive Enterprise private cloud levels.
  • AI in Cloud Engineering: Practical experience leveraging AI in daily engineering workflows. Ability to effectively use LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) for coding, debugging, and system design, alongside knowledge of AIOps platforms for predictive maintenance.
  • Deep Virtualization Knowledge: Proficiency in managing KVM/QEMU-based environments, understanding of CPU resource allocation (pinning, NUMA nodes), and memory optimization.
  • Networking Expertise: Understanding of physical and virtual networking (VLAN, VXLAN, BGP, EVPN). Grasp of how packets travel between a physical NIC and a virtual machine interface.
  • Distributed Storage: Advanced knowledge of Software-Defined Storage solutions, specifically Ceph (Block, Object, File storage) and its integration with Cinder/Glance.
  • Linux Kernel & Operating Systems: Expert knowledge in Linux system administration at the kernel level, performance troubleshooting, and system tuning.
  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Understanding of distributed consensus mechanisms (e.g., etcd, RabbitMQ, Galera/MySQL in clusters) that form the heart of cloud stability.
  • Fluent English; German is a strong advantage

 

Job responsibilities

  • Low-Level Architecture Design: Selection and configuration of appropriate hardware components (servers, networking, storage) and mapping them to OpenStack services.
  • AI-Driven Engineering & Automation: Applying an “AI-First” approach to infrastructure: utilizing AI assistants and LLMs to accelerate Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development, generate complex automation scripts, and validate architectural decisions.
  • OpenStack Deployment: Installation and configuration of core OpenStack projects (e.g., Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Swift, Keystone, Glance, Horizon) in a High Availability (HA) model.
  • Software-Defined Networking & Storage (SDN / SDS): Implementation of advanced network topologies and data storage systems (e.g., OpenStack integration with Ceph, OVS/OVN configuration, BGP).
    Cloud Lifecycle Management: Building CI/CD pipelines to manage the cloud infrastructure itself, enabling automated upgrades of the OpenStack environment.
  • AIOps & Observability Strategy: Implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting systems enhanced by Machine Learning/AI (AIOps) to detect anomalies, correlate events, and predict hardware or hypervisor failures before they impact user VMs.
  • Security & Multitenancy: Designing secure resource isolation between different projects/tenants within the cloud and implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

Які задачі чекають на тебе:

  • Backend Architecture: Проєктування та розробка вебзастосунків з використанням Django (DRF) або FastAPI.
     
  • Database: Участь у проєктуванні архітектури бази даних для систем обліку продуктів та логування.

  • Впевнене володіння ORM (Django ORM або SQLAlchemy): вміння писати ефективні запити без N+1 проблем.

item.title: Mechanical Prototyping Engineer (CAD, 3D Printing, CNC)
item.description:
As the Mechanical Prototyper, you will turn Edgerun's engineering designs into real, working parts in Ukraine. You will take CAD and instructions from our engineers abroad, get parts made with local suppliers and our in-house 3D printer, and fit them onto the world's most advanced powered exoskeleton in the hands of the units using it.


You will report to the Country Director and work directly with the international engineering team, so design changes move from drawing to hardware in days, not weeks.


This is a hands-on builder role, not a design role. You should thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, be comfortable making decisions independently, and bring the energy, attitude, and ownership to build a rapid prototyping operation from the ground up.


Responsibilities

  • Get parts made from engineering CAD: CNC aluminum, laser-cut and bent sheet metal, metal and nylon 3D printing, and carbon fiber
  • Work with suppliers to make designs manufacturable: tolerances, threads, radii, and simpler geometry so a three-axis shop can turn a part in a day
  • Run the field office 3D printer for same-day prints
  • Hand-fit, bend, drill, and assemble parts, and repair one or two units when asked
  • Fit new parts onto units in Kyiv and upgrade the fleet between hardware versions
  • Build and keep a bench of fast local shops, and know who can move your job up the queue
  • Keep tools, materials, spares, and the Kyiv workshop organized and ready
  • Work closely with the Country Director and the engineering team to keep information flowing between the workshop and engineering
  • Take ownership of problems and make fast, practical decisions without waiting for detailed direction


Basic Qualifications

  • Proven ability to produce and fit mechanical parts, with concrete examples of parts you made, not only parts you drew.
  • Strong CAD skills in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar, including editing someone else's model for manufacturability.
  • Solid working knowledge of CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, and 3D printing, enough to direct a supplier and catch their mistakes.
  • Hands-on workshop experience: assembly, hand tools, drilling, bending, and fitting.
  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings and applying tolerances, fits, and thread specifications.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, making decisions independently, and developing processes where none exist.
  • Working English for daily collaboration with international engineers, and Ukrainian for communication with local suppliers and teams.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Kyiv, able to work full time on-site.


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience at a Ukrainian drone or UGV company, or at a small CNC or fabrication shop
  • Existing relationships with Kyiv suppliers and workshops
  • Basic electronics familiarity: soldering and wiring


How We Work

Hardware reaches real operators within days of concept, not months, and firmware updates ship over the air every one to two weeks. We are a small team with one owner per category. Nobody owns a slice of someone else’s problem.


Additional Requirements

Location: Kyiv, full time, in person
Travel: Across the country, if necessary
Hours: Occasional extended hours and weekends as needed

item.title: Hardware Test Engineer
item.description:
The role

You will own validation of our hardware from first prototype to serial production. Every board we ship goes to the front line, where a failure costs more than a warranty claim - your job is to find it first.

 

• Location: Kyiv, on-site 

• Employment: full-time

• Reports to: R&D lead

 

Responsibilities

• Write test plans and procedures for new PCBs and devices: bring-up, functional, RF, power and environmental tests

• Bring up first prototypes and debug failures down to component level together with the design engineers

• Measure RF performance of LoRa/BLE links: output power, sensitivity, antenna matching (VNA), range tests in field conditions

• Characterize power consumption in sleep and active modes and verify battery life against the 6–12 month target

• Run environmental tests: temperature (−20…+50 °C), humidity, ingress, vibration and drop

• Validate seismic sensor channels: sensitivity, noise floor, false-alarm rate on reference signals

• Build and maintain test jigs and fixtures (pogo-pin beds, programming stations) and automate tests in Python

• Define end-of-line production tests and pass/fail criteria; train assembly staff to run them

• Keep test reports, failure logs and root-cause analyses that feed back into the next hardware revision

• Join field trials with units to confirm lab results under real conditions

 

Requirements

• 2+ years in hardware testing, validation or electronics R&D

• Degree in electronics, radio engineering, physics or equivalent hands-on experience

• Confident with lab equipment: oscilloscope, multimeter, lab PSU, electronic load, spectrum analyzer or SDR, VNA

• Read schematics and layouts; comfortable with SMD soldering and rework

• Understand embedded systems: microcontrollers (STM32 or similar), UART/SPI/I2C, flashing and debugging firmware

• Python for test automation and data processing

• Methodical: you document what you test, how, and what came out - so anyone can repeat it

• Ukrainian fluent; technical English for datasheets and standards

 

Nice to have

• RF test experience: LoRa, sub-GHz radio, link budget and antenna measurements

• Low-power design and current profiling (nA–mA range, e.g. Power Profiler, Joulescope)

• Experience with sensors and signal processing: accelerometers, piezo, seismic or acoustic

• Knowledge of MIL-STD-810 / IEC 60068 environmental testing or IP-rating tests

• Production test experience: ICT, end-of-line fixtures, yield tracking

• Drone electronics: Betaflight/ArduPilot, ELRS, ESCs

• Background in defense, security or industrial electronics

 

What we offer

• Work that ships to the front within weeks, not years - you see the effect of your tests directly

• Ownership of the test function: you set up the lab process and production test from the ground up

• Competitive salary, reviewed after probation

• Reservation from mobilization (бронювання) for employees

• Modern lab: VNA, spectrum analyzer, climate chamber, in-house CNC and prototyping

• Small team, short decision loop - direct access to the founder and R&D lead

• Budget for equipment, courses and conferences
